meta.source: NASA Exoplanet Archive: Planetary Systems (PS) and Planetary Systems Composite Parameters (PSCompPars), transiting planets

units.t0: Julian date in the stated standard
units.pub: year of publication, with a fraction

meta.host: 0 means the host name is the planet name without its last letter
meta.clock: the working clock as [t0, e_t0, period, e_period, ref, pub, std, default, disputes]: default is 1 for the composite row with mid-time and period from one paper, 2 for one published solution, 0 for a mixed composite kept for want of a solution; disputes is how many other published solutions contradict it by more than 3 sigma on the day of retrieval; ref and std index the record file
meta.record: ephemerides-record.json holds refs and sols; sols[i] are the published solutions of rows[i], oldest first, undated last
meta.errors: the mean size of the upper and lower error bars the archive gives
meta.acknowledgement: This research has made use of the NASA Exoplanet Archive, which is operated by the California Institute of Technology, under contract with the National Aeronautics and Space Administration under the Exoplanet Exploration Program.
